tool.title: Retrieve a remote Knowledge Graph via npm package or tarball
tool.description: Retrieve and inspect a remote Knowledge Graph packaged as an npm package or tarball (.tgz), supporting both unhydrated source graph views (authored declarations, skills, schemas) and hydrated materialized graph views (subgraph JSON-LD, metadata indexes, dereferenced graph projections).

inputs.name: package
inputs.description: Package name, npm tarball (.tgz) path, or URL.

inputs.name: destination
inputs.description: Directory to unpack or install into.

inputs.name: view
inputs.description: Graph view to inspect/retrieve: 'unhydrated' (source graph), 'hydrated' (materialized JSON-LD/indexes), or 'both'.

inputs.name: release
inputs.description: Optional `folio-binary-release/v1` record to verify digest and size against.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Summary of retrieved graphs, nodes, and assets.

remedies.none: Retrieves packages from npm registry; local tarballs work offline via direct path.
Retrieves packages from GitHub Packages registry; local tarballs work offline via direct path.
